properties.label: Shared-border feature plates
properties.text: Join three adjacent feature plates with one continuous outline and single shared dividers. Each plate contains a FIG number, explanatory drawing, short title, paragraph and compact specification list.

properties.label: Silver technical hierarchy
properties.text: Use crisp silver typography with small monospace FIG labels and specification indices against the dark surface.

properties.label: Near-black grayscale plates
properties.text: Use a nearly black surface, crisp silver text and fine gray line drawings, reserving any small signal color for meaning.

properties.label: Literal technical feature drawings
properties.text: Use one coherent calibrated line grammar for three distinct subjects: branching source files, weighted input distribution and a decision ledger. Crosshairs and line terminals must describe actual relationships.

properties.label: Explanatory line motion
properties.text: A subtle packet or line draw may explain a connection, but every illustration remains complete at rest and repeated demonstrations yield to deliberate interaction.

properties.label: Distinct-plate acceptance
properties.text: Keep all three subjects visible and distinct at phone width. Do not replace them with icons, hide one to fit, or double the border at a shared edge.
